fine_lines.title: must not vs don't have to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: mustn't = ممنوع، لا تفعل ذلك. don't have to = ليس ضرورياً، أنت حر أن تفعل أو لا تفعل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Mustn't = it's not allowed; don't do it. Don't have to = it's not necessary; you can choose.

examples.sentence: You don't have to buy bread.

fine_lines.title: should vs must
fine_lines.explanation_ar: should نصيحة (فكرة جيدة). must أقوى: ضرورة أو قاعدة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Should is advice (a good idea). Must is stronger: it is necessary, or a rule.

grammar.title: should for advice
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم should + الفعل في المصدر لنقول إن شيئاً ما فكرة جيدة (نصيحة). النفي: shouldn't. لا نضيف s مع he/she: He should eat. ويمكن أن نقول should be able to = من المفروض أن تستطيع.
grammar.explanation_en: Use should + base verb to say something is a good idea (advice). Negative: shouldn't. No -s with he/she: He should eat. Should be able to = it's likely you can.
examples: I know I should eat healthy food.
You should be able to find all kinds of food there.

grammar.title: must / mustn't / don't have to
grammar.explanation_ar: must + الفعل = ضروري جداً (أقوى من should). mustn't (must not) = ممنوع. أما don't have to فمعناها «ليس ضرورياً». انتبه: mustn't و don't have to مختلفان تماماً.
grammar.explanation_en: Must + base verb = very necessary (stronger than should). Mustn't (must not) = do not do it. Don't have to = it's not necessary. Careful: mustn't and don't have to are very different.
examples: You don't have to buy bread.
